framingCorrectionApplied: 2026-07-08 operator: DROP revert-to-upstream. Never drop ANY fork behavior (essential or not). MOVE fork divergence into fork-only sources/fork/* overlays so upstream-canonical files stay near-upstream (merge clean, inherit upstream) while fork behavior is PRESERVED in the overlay. Axis: REDUCIBLE->MOVE vs IRREDUCIBLE->ACCEPT. essential/non-essential only informs overlay design.
verdict: MOVE-everything-reducible-to-overlays; permanent expensive floor ~5-7 irreducible ACCEPT files; zero fork behavior dropped

dispositionModel.MOVE: relocate fork divergence (essential OR tweak) into sources/fork/* + revert canonical to near-upstream + thin seam; canonical inherits upstream, fork behavior preserved. DEFAULT.
dispositionModel.ALIGN: rare/narrow; ONLY where a file carries NO intentional fork behavior (pure convergent noise). NOT reverting a feature. Provisionally EMPTY.
dispositionModel.ACCEPT: irreducible convergent core that can't be seamed (sync.ts/storage.ts + honest few adjacent monoliths).

MOVE.note: 5 R8 stages already shipped (HA-4/5/6/8/9); rest planned across waves

ALIGN.note: provisionally empty; criterion = no intentional fork behavior in the hunk; confirm per-hunk at code stage; small size alone is NOT ALIGN (e.g. 9-line e-ink cap is fork intent -> MOVE)

ACCEPT_irreducible.note: HA-7 i18n ACCEPT if not MOVE-list'd

fork_owned_wholesale.note: whole file is fork content; nothing to move out; take-ours; no upstream feature to inherit

headlineReduction: 59 app hard-conflict files -> MOVE ~31 to fork-only overlays + thin seams (inherit upstream, preserve fork behavior), KEEP-DELETED 8 guards, merge=ours 3 shims, leaving a permanent EXPENSIVE floor of ~5-7 irreducible ACCEPT files (sync.ts + storage.ts the hard core). Zero fork behaviors dropped.
honestCaveat: MOVE does NOT zero the conflict-MARKER count: R8/M1 finding (findings-v2 §2.3) = relocation removed ZERO hard-conflict FILES at a snapshot because the canonical still carries a thin seam that can re-collide. What MOVE removes is RESOLUTION COST + FREQUENCY: whole-file re-derivation -> 1-line seam re-apply that mostly auto-merges. The ~5-7 ACCEPT are the expensive residue; the ~31 MOVE seams are the cheap residue.
newLever_move_list_concat_from_fork: Catalogue/list files (model catalogue, slash commands, tool registry, i18n, suggestion caps): canonical consumes upstream_list.concat(FORK_ROWS) with FORK_ROWS in a fork-only module -> canonical reverts near-upstream + auto-merges + inherits upstream's new rows, fork rows preserved.
planeRemovalResidual: typesRaw/persistence/route-layouts/SettingsView diverge by DELETING an upstream plane; you cannot overlay an absence, so their canonical can only be 'upstream minus the guarded removed plane' = thin residual divergence even after MOVE-ing fork additions out. This is why ACCEPT-adjacent is slightly bigger than just sync.ts/storage.ts.
essentialBoundaryRole: No longer decides keep-vs-drop (we keep everything). Now informs overlay DESIGN: what must stay behavior-identical (default-off toggles, byte-identical e-ink render) + which guards to preserve (guard-by-absence for removed planes) + which files can only be 'upstream minus a guarded removal'.

specialCaseRulings.new_index_tsx: MOVE (not revert): relocate fork lean e-ink+daemon screen (incl E2 remote-daemon pickers) to sources/fork/newSession/ behind a route flag; canonical near-upstream inherits upstream's richer screen by flag; fork screen preserved. Largest single file (1917 delta).
specialCaseRulings.voice_realtime: KEEP-DELETED. Keeping it removed is an INTENTIONAL divergence to maintain; the minimal-conflict reframe does NOT force restoring it (maintenance is cheap guard-tested take-ours; restore re-adds central-server broker E2 + mic->cloud egress + animated status bar E4 + 2 npm deps). Mic UI already inert (HA-6). Surface restore-vs-keep-removed; restore only on explicit request, bypass-only e-ink-static default-off.
specialCaseRulings.removed_planes: KEEP-DELETED guard by absence (HA-49..52 + voice). Every MOVE wave gates on encryptionDeletion.spec.ts + Test-Path==false; MOVE-partial files keep the removal as explicit guarded residual, never adopt upstream removed-plane code.
